scope: Current RC006 relation-aware serialization/data namespace only; this gate does not claim impossibility of extending RC006.
source_required_capabilities: nontrivial Lambda kernel/coefficient indexed by source labels
linear combination/sum of transformed intertwiner states
output representation alpha1(K) distinct from fixed input alpha1(K1)
domain-escape flag because alpha1(K) is not necessarily EPRL
independence_lock: Do not use historical holdout outcomes, favorable signs, amplitude values, or desired Eq29 result. Audit only code/schema expressivity against the already-qualified source structure.
acceptance: SUPPORTED only if the current RC006 namespace explicitly represents all five source-required capabilities without encoding a summed representation transformation as a single pair sign/order bit. PARTIAL if some but not all are explicit. INSUFFICIENT if none or only sign/order information exists.

downstream.SUPPORTED: A separately preregistered source-to-RC006 representation-aware mapping may proceed.
downstream.PARTIAL_OR_INSUFFICIENT: Do not retune pair signs. A new versioned namespace/schema extension must be prospectively designed before any representation-aware amplitude mapping.
